issues.title: Catskill Crew Events Calendar Launch | Hudson Valley Happenings
issues.author: Michael Kauffman
sections:
Old Man Blackwood — the least-liked man in the Catskill Mountains — gathered a handful of folks for a weekend of adventure.

By Sunday he was dead, and his body turned up in a place no one expected. The sheriff is snowed in two towns over and the bridge is out.
One of the guests is a killer, and until the roads clear it's up to you to prove who did it, where in the mountains it happened, and with what weapon.
Do you want to be first to know about Murder in the Mountains?
